title: astragalus nigricans
intro: Astragalus nigricans, commonly known as Black Vetch or Black Milkvetch, is a perennial legume native to the mountainous regions of China and the Himalayas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, helping to boost the immune system, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus nigricans are attributed to its ability to tonify Qi, promote circulation, and calm the mind, making it a valuable remedy for fatigue, weakness, and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus nigricans include saponins, flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
